meals.name: Ginisang Monggo with Malunggay & Red Rice
meals.description: Slow-simmered mung beans with fresh malunggay leaves, sautéed tomatoes, garlic, and half a boiled egg over red rice. Seasoned with calamansi instead of patis to protect kidney health.
steps: Sauté minced garlic, chopped red onion, ginger, and diced ripe tomatoes in 1 tsp cooking oil until soft.
Add pre-boiled mung beans and 1.5 cups water; simmer for 8 minutes and mash lightly for a thick broth.
Stir in fresh malunggay leaves and turn off the heat after 1 minute so the greens stay bright.
Season with cracked black pepper and calamansi instead of patis or bullion cubes to keep sodium under 300mg.

meals.name: Char-Grilled Tortang Talong & Tomato Ensalada
meals.description: Smoky broiled eggplant dipped in herb-beaten farm egg and pan-seared, served with fresh tomato-cucumber ensalada and rice.

ingredients.item: Whole farm egg with spring onions
Fresh tomato, cucumber & red onion ensalada

steps: Broil or roast the whole eggplant over a stove flame until charred and soft, then peel the skin and flatten with a fork.
Beat the egg with chopped spring onions, garlic powder, and cracked black pepper (no extra salt needed).
Coat the flattened eggplant in the egg and pan-sear in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve with fresh tomato-cucumber ensalada dressed in calamansi juice instead of bagoong.

meals.name: Crispy Tokwa & Garlic Kangkong Stir-Fry
meals.description: Pan-seared firm tokwa cubes tossed with crisp water spinach (kangkong), toasted garlic, ginger, and calamansi.
steps: Pat the tokwa dry, cut into bite-sized cubes, and pan-sear in a non-stick skillet until crisp and golden.
Sauté minced garlic and fresh ginger in the same pan for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Toss in the kangkong stalks for 1 minute, then add the leaves and seared tokwa.
Finish with fresh calamansi juice, cracked pepper, and a drop of sesame oil. Serve warm with rice.

meals.name: Adobong Talong & Tokwa sa Calamansi (Low-Salt)
meals.description: Braised eggplant and seared tofu simmered in native cane vinegar, roasted garlic, bay leaves, and whole peppercorns.

ingredients.item: Native cane vinegar, calamansi & 1 tsp soy

steps: Pan-sear eggplant wedges and cubed tokwa in a lightly oiled skillet for 4 minutes until golden.
Add crushed garlic, whole peppercorns, bay leaves, native cane vinegar, and 1/3 cup water.
Simmer covered on low heat for 6 minutes so the aromatics infuse without needing heavy soy sauce.
Squeeze fresh calamansi juice before serving with warm rice.

meals.name: Rolled Oats, Lakatan Banana & Chia Yogurt Bowl
meals.description: Whole rolled oats folded with unsweetened yogurt, ripe local lakatan banana, chia seeds, and pumpkin seeds.
steps: Stir rolled oats, plain yogurt, chia seeds, and low-fat milk together in a bowl or cup.
Simmer gently for 3 minutes for warm oatmeal, or chill for 10 minutes for overnight-style oats.
Top with freshly sliced lakatan banana and pumpkin seeds.

meals.name: Silken Egg Drop, Corn & Malunggay Soup Bowl
meals.description: Clear ginger broth ribbons with two farm eggs, sweet corn kernels, soft tofu cubes, and fresh malunggay leaves.
steps: Simmer fresh ginger, garlic, and sweet corn in 2.5 cups water for 6 minutes to build a naturally sweet broth.
Add cubed soft tofu, then stir the broth in a gentle circle while pouring beaten eggs to create silky ribbons.
Turn off the heat and fold in fresh malunggay leaves and chopped spring onions.

meals.name: Sesame Tofu, Broccoli & Edamame Rice Bowl
meals.description: Seared ginger-sesame tofu served with steamed broccoli florets, julienned carrots, cucumber, and brown rice.
steps: Sear cubed tofu in 1 tsp sesame oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden.
Blanch broccoli and carrot strips in boiling water for 2 minutes until tender-crisp.
Coat the warm tofu in grated ginger, rice vinegar, and 1 tsp low-sodium soy glaze, then serve over brown rice.

meals.name: Native Ginger Chicken Tinola with Green Papaya
meals.description: Kidney-friendly ginger chicken soup simmered with skinless chicken breast, green papaya, malunggay, and dahon ng sili.
steps: Sauté julienned ginger, crushed garlic, and sliced red onion in 1 tsp oil until fragrant.
Add skinless chicken pieces and sear for 3–4 minutes until lightly golden.
Pour in 2.5 cups water and simmer covered for 12 minutes, then add green papaya wedges for 5 minutes.
Fold in malunggay and chili leaves and season with black pepper instead of patis.

meals.name: Wok-Tossed Vegetable & Egg Brown Fried Rice
meals.description: High-heat wok-tossed brown rice with scrambled farm eggs, green peas, diced carrots, cabbage, and spring onions.
steps: Heat a wok over high heat with 1 tsp oil and scramble the eggs until just set.
Sauté garlic, diced carrots, peas, and shredded cabbage for 2 minutes.
Toss in chilled brown rice over high heat and finish with spring onions and cracked pepper.

meals.name: Chunk Tuna & Crisp Romaine Whole-Wheat Wraps
meals.description: Rinsed chunk tuna in water tossed with yogurt-calamansi dressing, diced tomatoes, cucumber, sweet corn, and romaine.
steps: Drain and briefly rinse the chunk tuna in drinking water to remove 40% of surface sodium, then flake into a bowl.
Toss with diced tomato, cucumber, sweet corn, plain yogurt, and fresh calamansi juice.
Spoon onto crisp romaine leaves inside a whole-wheat tortilla and roll tightly.

meals.name: Calamansi-Herb Grilled Chicken & Mango Ensalada
meals.description: Calamansi-oregano marinated chicken breast grilled juicy and served with fresh tomato-cucumber-mango ensalada.

ingredients.item: Tomato, cucumber, onion & green mango salad

steps: Marinate chicken breast in calamansi juice, minced garlic, oregano, and black pepper for 10 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Slice and plate alongside fresh tomato-cucumber ensalada and brown rice.

meals.name: Pan-Seared Garlic Bangus Belly & Pechay Plate
meals.description: Boneless Dagupan bangus marinated in native cane vinegar, crushed garlic, and peppercorns with steamed pechay.
steps: Marinate boneless bangus in cane vinegar, crushed garlic, and black pepper (no salt needed).
Pan-sear skin-side down in 1 tsp oil for 4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Serve with steamed pechay leaves, fresh tomatoes, and warm brown rice.

meals.name: Grilled Yellowfin Tuna Steak & Mango Ensalada
meals.description: Thick-cut General Santos yellowfin tuna loin seared with calamansi and herbs, paired with mango-tomato ensalada and red rice.

ingredients.item: Calamansi, olive oil, garlic & cracked pepper
Ripe mango, cucumber, tomato & cilantro salad

steps: Brush the yellowfin tuna steak with olive oil, calamansi juice, minced garlic, and cracked black pepper.
Sear on a hot grill pan for 3–4 minutes per side so the center stays tender and moist.
Serve over upland red rice with chilled mango-cucumber-tomato ensalada.

meals.name: Sinigang na Salmon Belly in Fresh Guava-Tamarind Broth
meals.description: Norwegian salmon belly simmered in natural boiled sampalok and ripe guava broth (zero MSG sinigang mix) with kangkong and labanos.
meals.difficulty: High Tier · Zero-MSG Natural Sour Broth
steps: Boil fresh tamarind pods with quartered tomatoes and red onion for 8 minutes, then mash and strain the natural sour extract (skip commercial high-sodium sinigang packets).
Simmer labanos slices, sitaw, and okra in the natural tamarind broth for 5 minutes.
Add the fresh salmon belly strips and simmer gently for 4 minutes until flaky.
Fold in fresh kangkong leaves, turn off heat, and serve hot with brown rice.

meals.name: Roast Beef Tenderloin Strips, Garlic Broccoli & Quinoa Bowl
meals.description: Lean grass-fed beef tenderloin strips seared with toasted garlic, steamed broccoli florets, bell peppers, and tri-color quinoa brown rice.

ingredients.item: Fresh broccoli florets & red bell pepper
Toasted garlic, ginger & black pepper glaze

steps: Season lean beef tenderloin strips with cracked black pepper, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Sear quickly in a hot skillet for 2 minutes per side so the beef stays tender.
Toss in blanched broccoli florets and sliced red bell peppers for 1 minute, then plate over warm quinoa-brown rice.

meals.name: Roast Chicken & Calamansi Greens Bowl
meals.description: Prepared fresh daily with lean protein, crisp local vegetables, and controlled sodium seasoning for a balanced meal.

Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger in 1 tsp vegetable oil over medium heat until fragrant (about 2 minutes).

reels.title: ₱85 Sesame Tofu & Broccoli Rice Bowl
reels.creator: Chef Mia · Campus Fresh
reels.caption: Pan-seared firm tofu tossed in a light ginger-sesame glaze with crisp steamed broccoli and brown rice.
reels.narration: To make the 85-peso Sesame Tofu Bowl: Sear cubed firm tofu in one teaspoon of sesame oil until golden. Blanch broccoli and carrots for two minutes, coat with ginger-soy glaze, and serve over brown rice.

comments.text: Cooked this in my dorm with one pan—super filling for ₱85!

reels.title: ₱95 Ginger Chicken Tinola with Malunggay
reels.creator: Kusina Healthy PH
reels.caption: Clear ginger broth simmered with lean chicken breast, green papaya wedges, and fresh malunggay leaves.
reels.narration: For Low-Sodium Chicken Tinola: Sauté fresh ginger, garlic, and red onion. Sear skinless chicken breast, simmer in water for 12 minutes with green papaya, and fold in fresh malunggay leaves.

comments.text: Fresh ginger and calamansi give so much flavor without needing patis.

reels.title: ₱125 Calamansi-Herb Grilled Chicken Plate
reels.creator: Coach Anton · Cubao Fit
reels.caption: 38g protein per serving! Calamansi-oregano marinated chicken breast seared juicy with fresh tomato ensalada.
reels.narration: Marinate lean chicken breast in calamansi juice, minced garlic, oregano, and black pepper. Grill for five minutes per side, let rest for three minutes, and serve with fresh tomato and cucumber ensalada.

reels.title: ₱50 Student-Saver Ginisang Monggo Bowl
reels.creator: Green Karinderya Cubao
reels.caption: Our ₱50 campus favorite: slow-simmered mung beans, fresh malunggay leaves, diced tomatoes, egg, and red rice.
reels.narration: Here is how to cook our 50-peso Ginisang Monggo: Sauté garlic, onion, ginger, and ripe tomatoes. Add boiled mung beans, simmer until creamy, and stir in fresh malunggay leaves right before serving.

comments.text: Best ₱50 meal near campus! So easy to prep at home too.

reels.title: ₱70 5-Minute Rolled Oats & Lakatan Bowl
reels.creator: ByteBite Morning Kitchen
reels.caption: Rolled oats, unsweetened plain yogurt, sliced lakatan banana, and chia seeds ready in 5 minutes.
reels.narration: Combine half a cup of rolled oats with plain yogurt, chia seeds, and milk. Simmer briefly or chill for ten minutes, then top with fresh sliced lakatan banana and toasted pumpkin seeds.

reels.title: ₱110 High-Protein Tuna Romaine Wraps
reels.creator: Araneta Night Fuel
reels.caption: 29g protein with zero stove time: flaked tuna in water, yogurt-calamansi dressing, corn, and crisp romaine.
reels.narration: Drain chunk light tuna and toss with diced tomato, cucumber, sweet corn, plain yogurt, and calamansi juice. Spoon onto crisp romaine leaves inside a whole-wheat wrap and roll tightly.

reels.title: ₱60 Crispy Tokwa & Kangkong High-Heat Wok
reels.creator: Chef Mia · Campus Fresh
reels.caption: How to get crispy golden tofu without deep-frying, tossed with garlic water spinach in 10 minutes.
reels.narration: Pat firm tofu completely dry, cube it, and sear in a non-stick wok until crisp. Add minced garlic, ginger, and fresh kangkong stalks, toss for 60 seconds, and finish with calamansi and sesame oil.

reels.title: ₱95 Wok-Tossed Vegetable & Egg Brown Rice
reels.creator: Araneta Night Fuel
reels.caption: High-heat wok technique for fluffy, non-greasy brown fried rice loaded with eggs, peas, carrots, and cabbage.
reels.narration: Scramble two farm eggs in a hot wok, then stir-fry garlic, diced carrots, peas, and shredded cabbage. Toss in chilled brown rice over high heat and finish with chopped spring onions.

reels.title: ₱65 Braised Eggplant & Tofu Adobo Skillet
reels.creator: Green Karinderya Cubao
reels.caption: Simmered in cracked black pepper, bay leaves, crushed garlic, and fresh calamansi for deep savory flavor.
reels.narration: Sear eggplant wedges and cubed tofu until lightly browned, then braise for six minutes with crushed garlic, bay leaves, whole peppercorns, and a squeeze of fresh calamansi.

reels.title: ₱75 Silken Egg Drop & Malunggay Corn Soup
reels.creator: Kusina Healthy PH
reels.caption: The whirlpool technique for silky egg ribbons in ginger broth with sweet corn, soft tofu, and malunggay.
reels.narration: Simmer ginger stock with sweet corn and soft tofu. Stir the broth in a gentle circle while pouring beaten eggs to create delicate ribbons, then fold in fresh malunggay leaves.

reels.title: ₱135 Pan-Seared Garlic Bangus & Pechay Plate
reels.creator: Coach Anton · Cubao Fit
reels.caption: Boneless milkfish marinated in native cane vinegar and crushed garlic, pan-seared crisp with steamed pechay.
reels.narration: Marinate boneless bangus fillet in native vinegar, crushed garlic, and black pepper. Pan-sear skin-side down for four minutes per side and plate with blanched pechay and brown rice.

reels.title: ₱55 Char-Grilled Tortang Talong & Ensalada
reels.creator: Green Karinderya Cubao
reels.caption: Smoky roasted eggplant omelette seared in 1 tsp oil and served with crisp tomato-cucumber ensalada.
reels.narration: Char-broil a whole eggplant until tender, peel the skin, and flatten with a fork. Dip in beaten egg with scallions, pan-sear for three minutes per side, and serve with fresh tomato ensalada.
